title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted three Houthi missiles toward Riyadh
summary: The Saudi-led coalition said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis toward Riyadh. Reuters reported that its witness saw a projectile and heard a loud bang, while an AFP journalist reported hearing two explosions. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: The Saudi-led coalition’s statement
Cites the Saudi-led coalition and a Reuters witness in Riyadh who saw a projectile and heard a loud bang.
Cites the coalition's statement on X and an AFP journalist in Riyadh who heard two explosions.
Cites the coalition spokesman's announcement on X, Civil Defense alerts and witnesses who heard explosions.
Attributes the interception announcement to coalition spokesperson Turki Al-Malki on X.

responses.text: The coalition said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis toward Riyadh.
Civil Defense said it lifted the alert for Riyadh and that the danger had passed.
The Houthis said on X that they were striking targets across Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh.

title: Magnitude 6.7 earthquake shakes central Peru, AP reports, citing USGS
summary: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake shook central Peru, AP reported, citing the U.S. Geological Survey. Peru’s National Institute of Civil Defense said no injuries or material damage had been reported at the time of its report, according to EFE. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Cites the U.S. Geological Survey and Peru’s Geophysical Institute; also reports that residents in Lima rushed into the streets.
Cites and reproduces the Geophysical Institute of Peru’s seismic report.
Reports preliminary seismic data for the Junín earthquake.
Cites Peru’s National Institute of Civil Defense and Geophysical Institute; the article is carried by Infobae.

responses.who: Peru’s National Institute of Civil Defense
responses.text: According to EFE, the institute said no injuries or material damage had been reported at the time of its report.
According to AP, the institute said no damage or casualties had been reported and there was no tsunami threat.

title: Peru’s Geophysical Institute reports magnitude 6.7 earthquake near Junín
summary: Peru’s Geophysical Institute reported a magnitude 6.7 earthquake northwest of Junín at a depth of 129 km, and AP reported that it was felt in Lima. Andina attributed later reports of damage to homes and a hospital, road blockages and power cuts to civil defense chief Luis Vásquez. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Cites the U.S. Geological Survey, Peru’s Geophysical Institute and a local television interview with Carhuamayo’s mayor.
Reuters cites the German Research Centre for Geosciences, Peru's Geophysical Institute, television footage and a Junín council member's remarks to RPP. GMA News carries the Reuters report.
RPP reports remarks made to it by the head of Peru's civil defense agency and cites the Geophysical Institute's seismic report.
EFE cites Peru's civil defense and geophysical agencies, statements by local officials to Peruvian media, and its own photographs from Lima.
Andina cites Peru's Geophysical Institute and describes residents leaving buildings in Lima and Callao.

responses.text: The institute reported a magnitude 6.7 earthquake at 7:09 p.m. local time, 30 km northwest of Junín, at a depth of 129 km.

responses.who: Peru’s civil defense chief Luis Vásquez
responses.text: According to Andina, Vásquez reported damage to homes and a hospital, road blockages and power cuts after initially reporting no damage.

title: AP: Countries agree to pursue possible autonomous weapons agreement by 2028
summary: Countries at a UN weapons conference in Geneva agreed to work toward a possible agreement on lethal autonomous weapons by 2028 without committing to binding rules, AP reported. Brazil's ambassador, Frederico Meyer, said technology was advancing faster than diplomacy, according to AP. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: A diplomat who attended the talks and the outcome of the conference; the article is carried by Business Recorder.
Conference outcome and comments from Brazil's ambassador.

responses.text: He said technology was advancing faster than diplomacy, according to AP.

title: Reuters and AP report agreement to pursue an international instrument on autonomous weapons
summary: Countries at UN weapons talks in Geneva agreed to work toward an international instrument on lethal autonomous weapons over two years, Reuters and AP reported. Whether the instrument would be legally binding remained undecided, the outlets reported. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Reporting from Geneva, including remarks by the meeting's chair and a diplomat involved in the talks; published here by StreetInsider.
Reporting from Geneva, including remarks by Brazil's ambassador and accounts from advocacy groups.

responses.text: According to Reuters, Thoeni described the agreement as a significant achievement for humanitarian disarmament.

title: Reuters reports magnitude 6.8 earthquake in Banda Sea, citing GFZ
summary: Reuters, citing GFZ, reported a magnitude 6.8 earthquake northeast of Dili, Timor-Leste, at a depth of 117 km. RTM reported that METMalaysia measured the earthquake at magnitude 6.7 and said its initial assessment found no tsunami threat to Malaysia. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: German Research Centre for Geosciences (GFZ)
Reports a statement from the Malaysian Meteorological Department (METMalaysia), which measured the earthquake at magnitude 6.7.

responses.text: According to RTM, METMalaysia said its initial assessment found no tsunami threat to Malaysia.

title: Reuters reports Democrats are preparing an agenda for their first 100 days in the congressional majority
summary: Reuters reported that congressional Democrats are preparing a legislative agenda for their first 100 days in the majority, with an announcement likely in early December after the Senate leadership contest. AP separately reported on agenda discussions at a private Democratic caucus luncheon, without confirming that timing. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Lawmakers and aides, interviews with members of Congress, and public government figures; article republished by Investing.com.
Reports on Schumer’s presentation at a private caucus luncheon and interviews Democratic senators; it does not independently confirm Reuters’ expected announcement date.

Reports that Senate Democrats began discussing their agenda and cites two people granted anonymity to describe private discussions about the leadership election; it does not independently confirm Reuters’ expected announcement date.

responses.text: AP reported that Jeffries said Democrats would unite behind restoring Affordable Care Act tax breaks, reversing Medicaid cuts, holding votes against the Iran war and undoing President Trump’s tariffs.

title: AP: Joel Webbon outlines plans to seek political influence and elected offices
summary: Joel Webbon told The Associated Press he plans to build political influence and seek elected offices after Republicans’ midterm losses. According to the supplied AP report, the White House did not respond to its request for comment. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Reporter attended Webbon's conference and interviewed Webbon, attendees and researchers.
Ali Breland reports speaking directly with Webbon about his plan after the midterms, and also cites conversations with Nick Fuentes and a scholar.
Donie O’Sullivan reports from Irving on the conference and quotes Webbon’s speech. The linked article carries CNN’s reporting.

responses.text: According to AP, the White House did not respond to its request for comment.

title: AP review identifies sheriff races where immigration enforcement cooperation played a role in defeats
summary: The Associated Press reported that its review of about 250 sheriff elections identified several races in which cooperation with federal immigration enforcement played a role in a candidate's defeat. Maryland Matters separately reported on Frederick County Sheriff Chuck Jenkins' defeat, interviewing Jenkins and a local organizer about his immigration stance. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: AP reviewed about 250 sheriff elections and interviewed candidates, voters, activists and local officials.
Interviewed Sheriff Chuck Jenkins and a local organizer about his defeat and the role of his immigration stance.
Reported the Alamance County election result, Johnson's statement and his office's participation in the ICE agreement, drawing on its prior reporting.

responses.who: Terry Johnson, outgoing Alamance County, North Carolina, sheriff
responses.text: Johnson told AP that immigration policy likely did not cause his defeat, citing his long tenure and the political environment for Republicans. He said he followed the law and protected public safety.
Jenkins defended the county's ICE partnership as effective for public safety and said he did not regret his position, even if it may have cost him reelection, according to Maryland Matters.

title: AccuWeather forecasts Pacific storms along the West Coast through Thanksgiving week
summary: AccuWeather meteorologists forecast a series of Pacific storms bringing rain, snow and wind to the U.S. West Coast through Thanksgiving week. The Weather Channel's meteorologists also describe possible multiple storms, while the National Weather Service Weather Prediction Center forecasts heavy rain and strong winds from northern California through the Pacific Northwest. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: AccuWeather meteorologists and the article's author, a senior meteorologist
Its meteorologists describe computer forecast models indicating possible multiple storms before and during Thanksgiving.
Reports National Weather Service forecasts and cites meteorologists and San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie.

responses.who: National Weather Service Weather Prediction Center
responses.text: Its November 21 forecast describes heavy rain and strong winds from northern California through the Pacific Northwest, with wet weather continuing through Thanksgiving.
